China's Trade Surplus Exceeds $1 Trillion for Second Consecutive Year

China's trade surplus has surpassed $1 trillion for the second year in a row, driven by a 35% surge in exports. This growth is partly attributed to a boom in artificial intelligence (AI) related products, which are powering the export increase. Despite the significant surplus, some coverage suggests this economic performance may not be entirely positive for China's economy.
